meta.power_note: n=83; individual-level and brain-axis views are descriptive, not powered for causal inference. Interpret with caution.

methods.transform: CLR after multiplicative zero replacement (0.65x detection limit)
methods.network: CLR + graphical lasso; StARS stability selection (beta=0.05) chooses penalty; edges = glasso support retained at per-edge selection frequency >= threshold. Reported per edge: penalized partial correlation (sign/strength), StARS selection frequency (stability), and marginal CLR Spearman r with BH-FDR q (independent corroboration).
methods.subject_clustering: PAM/k-medoids (vendored) on Aitchison (Euclidean on CLR functional pathway profile)

functional_annotation.kegg_regroup_note: HUMAnN UniRef90->KO regroup (map_ko_uniref90) recovered only 1/46 pathway-less nodes: uncultured SGBs have no gene-family attribution in this run; resolving them needs UniRef50 re-run or assembly, not regrouping. Unannotated nodes use neighbor-inferred categories (labeled 'Inferred:'), never fabricated pathways.

clustering_diagnostics.distance: Aitchison (Euclidean on CLR functional pathway profile)

taxonomic_sensitivity.note: Subject clusters defined on FUNCTION; taxonomy shown for comparison only.

network_feature_sensitivity.feature: per-subject CLR co-abundance product over group edges

covariate_association.note: Post hoc only; covariates never define clusters. Exploratory; BH-FDR across covariates.

cluster_cognition_ageadjusted.note: Descriptive; age and cognitive measures are collinear (n=83). Behavioral performance (RKN, SubMem) is GMm-only (n~42); BH-FDR across all variables.

meta.individual_view_note: Individual mode shows cluster exemplars only. Full per-subject data not included in this public release.
